summary: Pin pty to 6336c376 (was e237afa8): the build links the pty client, core and terminal crates at 6336c376 and builds the pty binary from it; it brings pty #182, 'preserve explicit controls for legacy PTY owners without boot evidence', and 49 other commits

replay.detail: No claim replay or recovery behavior changes in this repository; the pty client library and binary carry the pty changes listed below (terminal history reads, owner identity checks, registry listing, legacy-owner controls).

schema.detail: No tables, indexes, triggers, schema-version changes or data rewrites in this repository. pty's own session registry records gain owner-identity fields; pty reads older records conservatively (Unknown owners stay listed and are refused for signalling).

rules.detail: No checkpoint rules or digest changes; no coordinated member upgrade required.
